shared_elements: standing/frontal anthropomorphic figure carved on an upright slab
elaborate headdress or headgear atop the figure
low-relief carving covering the whole face of a vertical monument
ornamental pectoral/chest elements and disc-like motifs
secondary small motifs framing the main figure
justification: Both surfaces present a single vertically oriented monument whose whole face is occupied by an elaborately adorned anthropomorphic figure crowned by a large headdress, with disc/rosette-like ornaments on the chest region and smaller motifs framing the head, a fairly specific shared scheme. However, A shows a detailed, richly costumed figure in profile-ish action with an arm holding an object and dense glyph-like blocks in registers, while B is far more schematic and massive, a blocky faceless torso with a few incised curves and no narrative or sign-like accompanying elements.
